name: DROWL Paragraphs
description: Paragraphs UX/UI enhancements: a per-paragraph settings field, layout/slideshow defaults, and a suite of ready-made paragraph type submodules.
project_description:
Will presumably be substituted by https://www.drupal.org/project/drowl_paragraphs_bs in the future! 

 Important note: In the current state you need to do a lot of manual configuration to bring all the functionality to life. It was designed to work perfectly with our custom theme. Stay tuned for the upcoming releases - we will make it work more "out of the box".

 Paragraphs types and settings field extension for more flexible, beautiful and powerful paragraphs. It will add a field called "DROWL Paragraph Settings", which will give you a bunch of options, such as grid settings (Zurb Foundation XY-Grid), animations (by Animate.css), Paddings & Margins, Background-Images (even with parallax effect) ...

 You need to use a theme based on Zurb Foundation 6.x. We currently do not ship any CSS code with this module. Also there are custom options not related to foundation (such as "Box Styles") - however you can simply bring this to life by adding your own CSS for those options.

 You need to create your own "Container"-Paragraphs so you are able to nest other Paragraphs (or other containers) inside them to create even very complex layouts. We will probably create some example paragraphs in future releases, helping you to understand how it works.

 paragraphs

 the module is still under heavy development. We'll add further explanation here when we're finished.

 IMPORTANT version information: 
 There is NO upgrade path. And it's not required to update to 2.x.

If you still use the old classes, simply stay on 1.x. Anyway 1.x has no further development planned.

 4.x: 
 
 Semver release 
 Uses layout_paragraphs ( assuming layout_paragraphs:^2 from 4.2.0 on ) 
 Foundation XY-Grid classes 
 Provides separate SASS code ( https://www.npmjs.com/package/drowl-sass-base ) to compile modified CSS code in a custom theme 
 Uses release-it (NPM) to create module releases more easy 
 Drupal ^8.9 / 9 Support 
 
 8.x-3.x: 
 
 No further development. Upgrade to 4.x recommended (but dangerous). 
 2.x PLUS 
 
 
 Layout Builder 
 Uses entity_reference_layout 
 Media in Core support 
 
 
 
 8.x-2.x: 
 
 No further development. Upgrade to 4.x recommended (but dangerous). 
 Foundation XY-Grid classes 
 Dropped some options which are no longer supported by Foundation 
 Fixed various bugs 
 NO Drupal 9 Support 
 Use of fontawesome_iconpicker was replaced by micon. Use fontawesome_iconpicker_to_micon module for conversion. This is NOT automated in any way. 
 
 8.x-1.x: 
 
 No further development. Upgrade to 4.x recommended (but dangerous). 
 Foundation FLEX-Grid classes 
 Use of fontawesome_iconpicker was replaced by micon. Use fontawesome_iconpicker_to_micon module for conversion. This is NOT automated in any way.
